request: Pull YTD 2026 Federal Register documents where the DoD is a listed agency. Flatten to one row per document with title, type, publication date, first agency, doc URL, days_since_published, and calendar features. Publish to 'Prep Agent / 14 - Federal Register DoD Documents' on Tableau Server for defense-policy analysts.

sources.name: Federal Register DoD Documents
sources.description: Federal Register public v1 API. `/documents.json` with `conditions[agencies][]=defense-department` and a YTD publication_date filter returns Notices, Rules, and Proposed Rules where DoD is a listed agency. Envelope: {count, description, total_pages, next_page_url, results:[{title, type, abstract, document_number, html_url, publication_date, agencies:[{name,slug,...}], excerpts, ...}]}. Pagination via next_page_url; ~500+ docs YTD. No auth.

args.name: FedReg DoD Trend
args.features_description: Adds row-level calendar features parsed from publication_date (year, month, quarter, day_of_week, iso_week). Row-level FR DoD document detail.
args.stats_description: Long-form FR DoD statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over document type and primary agency). Includes daily_count, 30-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies vs baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True). Use to spot spikes in Proposed Rules from any DoD component or agency-level publishing pattern shifts.

outputs.name: FR DoD Documents
outputs.description: Row-level Federal Register documents where the DoD is a listed agency (YTD 2026). Includes title, type (Notice/Rule/Proposed Rule), abstract, document_number, html_url, publication_date, primary_agency (first listed), days_since_published. Plus calendar features. Source: federalregister.gov/api/v1/documents.json (DoD filter). Refresh: daily.

outputs.name: FR DoD Stats
outputs.description: Long-form Federal Register DoD trend statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over document type and primary agency). Includes 30-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies, lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month). Use to detect policy-publishing surges by DoD sub-component.
